input.command:
python3 -c "
import cv2, numpy as np

# Camera: fx = fy = 256.0, cx = cy = 255.5
# Let's inspect objects visible across all observations:
# obs_0014: cam at (0, 1.3), heading 0
# obs_0015: cam at (0, 1.3), heading 315 (-45 deg)
# obs_0016: cam at (0, 1.3), heading 270 (-90 deg)
# obs_0017: cam at (0, 1.8), heading 0
# obs_0018: cam at (0, 1.8), heading 90
# obs_0020: cam at (0, 1.8), heading 270

# Let's look at Plant 2 (foreground right pot in obs 14):
img14 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0014.png')
# Plant 2 pot is around x=380..470, y=380..490
b, g, r = img14[:,:,0], img14[:,:,1], img14[:,:,2]
pot2_mask = (r > 100) & (g > 40) & (g < 90) & (b < 50) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 350)
ys, xs = np.where(pot2_mask)
print('Plant 2 pot in obs 14: center x,y =', xs.mean(), ys.mean(), 'bottom y =', ys.max())
d_plant2 = 256 * 1.55 / (ys.max() - 255.5)
x_plant2 = (xs.mean() - 255.5) * d_plant2 / 256.0
print(f'Plant 2 rel pos: x={x_plant2:.2f}, y={d_plant2:.2f}')
print(f'Plant 2 world pos: x={x_plant2:.2f}, y={1.3 + d_plant2:.2f}')
"
